name: ADA4625-1 / ADA4625-2
tagline: ADI's 36 V JFET op-amp with 3.3 nV/√Hz, 18 MHz and rail-to-rail output, liked for I/V, headphone and phono stages.

lineage.note: Single launched with Rev 0 (10/2017); dual added in combined Rev A by mid-2019. No second sources.

part_numbers.note: Single, 8-lead SOIC_N_EP. ADI: Recommended for New Designs. Eval board EVAL-ADA4625-1ARDZ.
Dual, 8-lead SOIC_N_EP, stocked at Mouser. Eval board EVAL-ADA4625-2ARDZ.

key_specs.value: JFET; input CM includes V−; rail-to-rail output

reputation.summary: A niche modern pick with a few forum reports. A diyAudio member used it for DAC I/V and was "amazed… almost like a CFA op amp". A Head-Fi poster liked its "great clean sound" that "seems to help low end" in a headphone amp. diyAudio has threads on phono use. One rolling comment calls it "somewhat cold". Impressions, not measurements.
caveats: Exposed-pad SOIC-8 only; DIP-8 rolling needs an adapter that handles the EPAD as the datasheet directs.
At 18 MHz it can oscillate on long adapter leads or with poor decoupling.
About 4 mA per amplifier, so it runs warmer than low-power JFET parts.
Praise comes from a few forum posts, and the tonal descriptions contradict each other.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeit or remarking reports found. Single-source niche ADI part in an exposed-pad SOIC: buy from ADI, DigiKey, Mouser or Arrow/Verical. Treat cheap marketplace DIP-adapter "upgrade" modules with caution.

silicon_changes.identification: PCN 25_0070 compares old and new outlines. Check date code against the PCN effective date, and the Rev B package drawing against Rev A.
silicon_changes.summary: PCN 25_0070 revises the SOIC_N_EP package outline drawing alongside datasheet Rev B (03/2025); Mouser lists a PCN dated 2025-06-26. No die or electrical change is indicated, but the PCN body (assembly site, leadframe, EPAD size) is unread.

spec_deltas.after: Revised outline in datasheet Rev B / PCN 25_0070 (exact dimensional changes unconfirmed)

silicon_changes.audio_impact: None expected: package and documentation change only.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: outline change only; check footprint if relying on the EPAD land pattern or adapter fit.
